cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Saga Pattern on Salesforce'. Subtitle in white: 'Distributed Transactions Across Sales, Commerce, ERP, OMS, Billing, and Fulfillment'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Salesforce Transaction Boundary' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'Order Capture', 'Saga State Object', 'Platform Events' as bright white pill badges with micro icons. MID LAYER 'Integration Orchestration' vivid purple border — modules 'MuleSoft APIs', 'Queueable Apex', 'Event Relay' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Enterprise Systems' vivid teal/green border — modules 'ERP Reservation', 'Payment Authorization', 'Warehouse Fulfillment' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Saga Coordinator' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'Compensating Actions' and 'Idempotency Keys'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Order Saga' → 'Reserve' → 'Authorize' → 'Fulfill' → 'Compensate on Failure' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Salesforce Saga Anatomy'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Salesforce Saga Anatomy'. Subtitle 'Durable state beats fake distributed rollback'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Correlation ID with fingerprint icon', 'Idempotent command with repeat-safe icon', 'Compensation step with reverse arrow icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD: hidden transaction state' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD: durable saga state' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'submitOrder(orderId); callERP(orderId); callPayment(orderId); updateStatus(orderId, \\'Done\\');', right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'Saga__c s = createSaga(orderId); publishStep(s.Id, \\'RESERVE_INVENTORY\\'); saveCorrelationId(s.Id);'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Persist every step', 'Retry with idempotency', 'Compensate explicitly'. Footer bar: 'A saga is a business transaction log, not a long Apex transaction'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Saga Failure Handling on Salesforce'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Saga Failure Handling on Salesforce'. Subtitle 'Retries, reconciliation, and compensation must be separate paths'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — '503 Timeout → Retry with clock icon', 'Credit Failed → Compensate with warning icon', 'Unknown Outcome → Reconcile with magnifier icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD: retry everything' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD: classify failure' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'catch (Exception e) { System.enqueueJob(new OrderSagaWorker(saga.Id)); }', right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'if (status == 503) retryLater(saga); if (status == 409) compensate(saga); if (timeout) reconcile(correlationId);'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Classify errors', 'Query unknown outcomes', 'Never duplicate commands'. Footer bar: 'A retry policy without idempotency is a production incident waiting to happen'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.
